subject.title: Markdown table columns misaligned with CJK characters on Telegram and Discord

question: Should the open linked PR be ported into `packages/markdown-core`, replaced by a narrow credited PR, or left for the author to update before this issue can close?
rationale: The remaining fix is clear, but the active linked PR is dirty and targets obsolete paths, so maintainers need to choose the adoption path for that contributor work.

options.title: Port or replace into markdown-core
options.body: Move the useful display-width logic and tests into the active markdown-core renderer, credit the source PR, and close this issue only after that lands.

options.title: Wait for author update
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask the linked PR author to rework the branch against current markdown-core paths.

options.title: Close the linked PR without replacement
options.body: Leave the issue open but reject the stale branch if maintainers do not want to adopt the contributor patch.

recommendation.title: Port or replace into markdown-core
recommendation.body: Move the useful display-width logic and tests into the active markdown-core renderer, credit the source PR, and close this issue only after that lands.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is tied by history to the current markdown-core renderer and original table-mode implementation, making him the best available routing owner for the adoption choice.
